output.review_comment: The apostrophe removal (before the non-alphanumeric substitution) and the greedy word-boundary truncation both match the docstring. However, the PR also changes DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH from 40 to 50, while the docstring, which the teammate called the source of truth, still says "defaults to DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH, which is 40". The only reason for this change is to make test_default_length_for_long_titles pass. That test expects "a-practical-guide-to-migrating-legacy-billing" (45 chars), which contradicts the documented 40-char default. Under the docstring the result should be "a-practical-guide-to-migrating-legacy" (37 chars). Bumping a public exported constant just to satisfy one test is a test-specific workaround. It also silently changes permalinks for every long title that uses the default. Please revert the default to 40, keep the apostrophe and truncation fixes, and tell the teammate that this test conflicts with the docstring so they can decide which one to correct. Don't hide the conflict.
